admission_schema.reference_boundary: Task.rule_ids and Manifest.rule_specs shape/cardinality/uniqueItems enforced here; exact equality to Body records remains REFERENCES and is not claimed.
admission_schema.rules: Within count<=4, missing/duplicate/unknown present kind set gives INPUT_UNADMITTED/SCHEMA; malformed rule container/record/kind types are INPUT_CLOSED_SCHEMA/SCHEMA. Exactly one of each four known kinds required.
admission_schema.shape_failure: All unknown/missing/extra properties and other shape failures give INPUT_CLOSED_SCHEMA/SCHEMA.
admission_schema.versions: Present type-str Registry/Policy/TaskView/RuleSpec version other than V1, including inline registries, gives INPUT_UNADMITTED/SCHEMA. Missing/wrong-type version fields are closed shape failures.

bounds_exact_scope.local_arrays: Every known Body array and nested array uses its exact pinned maxItems. More than4 Body.rules entries is INPUT_RECORD_BOUND/BOUNDS before admission. Existing maxima remain unchanged.
bounds_exact_scope.priority: Bounds before schema admission. Evaluate independent length caps of present correctly typed known containers first; missing or wrong-type fields are deferred to SCHEMA, never indexed unsafely. Malformed content is never accepted by skipping a bounds term. Compute complete aggregate record formula only once all its required container shapes are available; otherwise schema must refuse.
bounds_exact_scope.record_formula: 2 + len(body.registry.seats) + sum(len(body[name]) for name in record_arrays) + sum(1 + len(manifest.registry_snapshot.seats) for manifest in body.input_manifests). The constant2 is one body Registry and one body Policy. Inline Registry copies and their Seats are charged each time. Body, keys/pins, statement/guard/node dictionaries, and result dictionaries are not counted as record objects. Refuse total>96 with INPUT_RECORD_BOUND/BOUNDS.
bounds_exact_scope.source_limits_excluded: Body-local bounds do not establish enclosing archive bytes, aggregate original bytes, Q_RECORDS source count, descriptor closure or external source bounds. Source/claim graph-node identity/count and uniqueness are later REFERENCES/GRAPHS checks.

text_mapping.Base64: encoded string maxLength5464 and pinned pattern-search; exempt from generic4096-byte literal text ceiling. Decoded bytes, zero pad bits and canonical base64 are later W04 checks.
text_mapping.Id: ASCII and<=32 UTF8 bytes; exact pinned pattern-search semantics still applied at SCHEMA. ASCII does not silently imply a new fullmatch rule.
text_mapping.Sha256: fixed pinned64-character pattern and maxLength; ASCII shape only, not digest verification.
text_mapping.asserted_utc: Explicit<=1024 UTF8 bytes; pinned64-character maximum remains separately in shape validation.
text_mapping.failure: Known text byte overflow gives INPUT_BYTE_FIELD_BOUND/BOUNDS.
text_mapping.ordinary_text: Known schema string fields have<=4096 UTF8 bytes unless a smaller or qualified byte cap below applies. Pinned character min/maxLength remains separately enforced.
text_mapping.other_smaller_character_caps: Seat.declared_label and SourceVersion.media_type keep pinned128-character limits and generic4096-byte ceiling. No extra exceptions to count_rules[2] qualified field cap were found.
text_mapping.schema_maxLength1024: Every known string field with pinned maxLength1024 also has<=1024 UTF8 bytes. This covers Challenge.reason, Claim.attribution, HistoryEntry.note, IdentityEvidence.assertion, OpaquePayload.omitted_scope/uncertainty, Provenance.author_claim/limitations, ReadingWithdrawal.reason, RunEvidence.model_id_claim/provider_claim/provider_run_id_claim, Seat.declared_model_id, StructuredPayload.omitted_scope/uncertainty, UpdateNotice.correction_text. Unreachable Reason.detail and UntrustedReceipt.claimed_verdict are not admitted entrypoints here.
text_mapping.unknown_or_wrong_type_fields: Do not invent a byte-limit interpretation for an unknown property or a wrong-type value. Such input cannot pass SCHEMA. Its memory/traversal remains globally capped by PREPARSE bytes/value/depth limits.

canonical_final: After successful prior stages, require existing canonical(parsed)==raw exactly; mismatch INPUT_NONCANONICAL/CANONICAL_BYTES. Preserve scalar UTF8, key order/escape rules and no final LF. This compares input serialization only, not source identity.

evaluator.algorithm: Explicit DFS frame stack<=128. Each frame performs basic validations then maintains ref/allOf/oneOf/properties/items continuation indices and child boolean result in that same frame. Schedule at most one child at a time; no all-array stack push. oneOf exactly one branch succeeds; allOf every branch succeeds.
evaluator.artifact: One exact pinned local schema, no arbitrary schema interface. Reject changed schema/unsupported construct INPUT_SCHEMA_UNSUPPORTED/BOOTSTRAP.
evaluator.contains: Only exact four pinned rule-kind contains fragments, implemented by same four-kind count check after verifying their exact pinned shape. No arbitrary contains engine.
evaluator.equality: Exact JSON structural equality with bool distinct from integer; no Python True==1 shortcut for const/enum/uniqueItems. Canonical complete item keys may implement uniqueItems with charged scratch/byte budgets.
evaluator.functions: No project recursion; short functions; no uncontrolled dynamic callbacks/dispatch or code in input. Existing json_value/canonical stdlib recursive internals remain explicit bounded-depth trusted exclusions.
evaluator.patterns: Only fixed precompiled re.search semantics for exact three pinned patterns; no fullmatch equivalence claim. Check string length before pattern processing.
evaluator.refs: Only pinned local #/$defs references, validated acyclic before candidate processing; metadata $schema is inert.

preparse_exact_order: type(raw) is bytes, else INPUT_TYPE/PREPARSE; then 0<len(raw)<=65536, else INPUT_BYTE_BOUND/PREPARSE, before copy/decode.
Strict UTF8 decoding and explicit BOM rejection, else INPUT_ENCODING/PREPARSE. No normalization.

Bounded left-to-right scan outside strings. Track quote/escape and container depth. First offending depth token gives INPUT_DEPTH/PREPARSE; first offending unsigned-number lexical token gives INPUT_INTEGER_TOKEN/PREPARSE. All numbers must be 0 or positive decimal with no leading zeros; reject sign including -0, fraction, exponent, NaN and infinity. Ignore numeric spellings inside strings. Every digit token is at most20 digits before int conversion; a longer otherwise unsigned decimal gives INPUT_INTEGER_BOUND/PREPARSE. At end unterminated quote or unmatched delimiter state gives INPUT_JSON/PREPARSE.

Call existing transport_schema.json_value(raw,65536); any TransportError becomes INPUT_JSON/PREPARSE. Do not infer precise reason from its message. Existing duplicate decoded keys, syntax, floats/constants and depth refusals remain in force.

Iterative bounded walk of every decoded object key and string value rejects any unpaired surrogate code point with INPUT_ENCODING/PREPARSE. Parser emits only JSON builtin types; do not accept caller-supplied mutable object trees.

public_interface.input: exact bytes only; nonempty; length<=65536; no conversion/fetch/decompression
public_interface.private_value: A bounded private parsed value may flow to the validator; public success does not return/copy it.

qualification: Freeze exact contract/control/addendum/schema/parser/runtime pins, obtain independent review, then implement only this boundary. Test-only existing jsonschema supplies shape parity, not wire semantics or resource/lexical/canonical oracles. Retain all raw first outcomes and additive corrections. Inherited full proof/runtime/recovery/interoperability/external-human/product gates remain binding.

resource_counters.ceiling_status: Explicit proposed work ceilings, not a guarantee every simultaneous field maximum fits. Owner must freeze counters and retain quota-refusal controls; no original cap is raised.
resource_counters.charging: Check quota before work/push/copy/encoding. Primitive steps count each schema application, ref dispatch, continuation transition, property/item schedule, contains count and uniqueness comparison. Byte budget counts each examined/encoded uniqueness byte. Exhaustion gives INPUT_WORK_BOUND at current stage with no partial dimensions. Raw byte scan and scalar walk are bounded separately by their declared byte/value caps.
resource_counters.frame_evidence: schema-path-inspection.json measured reachable pinned Body schema/reference DAG longest descent19 schema nodes, including union/ref transitions.128 frames is sufficient for this design if continuation state uses no extra frames and exactly one child is active. This is source inspection/computation, not formal proof or actual implementation evidence.

scope: Internal exact-byte PREPARSE, Body-local BOUNDS, admitted-profile closed shape and canonical-byte comparison only. Return no accepted_result/ReplayResult, source identity, source membership, semantics, graph correctness, aggregation, freshness or authority claim.
